incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2: policy-engine eu-central instance crashed while evaluating routing policy 'region_fallback_v1'. Error: panic: compile error: unexpected end of expression

runtime stack:
```
policy/eval/parser.go:89: compileExpr failed: unexpected EOF
policy/eval/engine.go:198: Evaluate()
```

Observed effects: rapid route flapping between eu-central <-> ap-southeast, some requests matched fallback to 'model-quantized-v2' (incompatible variant) causing correctness regressions and 504s. Alert fired: alert_9122 (5xx spike), alert_9123 (policy-crash). Paging on-call.

elaine (oncall): ack. i'm live. paging runtime and SRE.

sam (eng-sre): on it. i'm seeing ~30% of traffic for tenant group 'beta-partners' hitting the fallback path. logs show `parse error: missing ')'` in the policy expression for region matcher. exporting snippet.

javier (eng-runtime): looks like someone pushed a policy change last night that introduced an expression fragment `region =~ /eu-.*` without closing delim or flags. policy loader tried to compile at runtime; compile error bubbled up as panic.

priya (eng-reliability): impact assessment: 1) correctness regression for a subset of inference calls (rankings shifted) 2) increased 5xxs and latency because requests retried across regions 3) a few customers reported content mismatch. estimated affected requests: ~0.6% of global p50 over last 8m.

tess (support): ticket from BetaRetail #3344: "responses inconsistent or empty occasionally". they gave examples that line up with model-quantized-v2 outputs.

elaine (oncall): mitigation plan: A) temporarily disable region_fallback_v1 B) add a short-lived route override to pin beta-partners to model-stable-2 C) restart policy-engine pods in eu-central after config cleanup D) create a quick validation job to simulate policy parsing on apply. thoughts?

sam (eng-sre): agree. i can flip disable now, then apply route override. would prefer rolling restart to avoid global blip.

mohit (platform): i can also add a circuit-breaker to prevent fallback to known-incompatible model variants when policy subsystem is unstable. we should block model-quantized-v2 fallbacks until we verify compatibility map.

javier (eng-runtime): i'll remove the bad policy revision from the config store and re-upload sanitized version. commands: `kv get /policies/region_fallback_v1/revisions` -> identify bad rev -> `kv rm /policies/region_fallback_v1/revs/2026-03-15T01:12` -> reapply. prepping sanitized JSON now.

incident-bot: Applying policy disable: `PATCH /api/policies/region_fallback_v1 {"enabled":false}` by elaine at 2026-03-15T17:04:12Z

elaine (oncall): override route: `POST /api/routes -d '{"tenant":"beta-partners","model":"model-stable-2","ttl_seconds":1800}'` 60s testing window.

sam (eng-sre): override applied. traffic shows beta-partners now 100% to model-stable-2. 5xxs starting to drop.

javier (eng-runtime): removed bad revision + reuploaded sanitized policy. rolling restart initiated: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/policy-engine -n prod -l region=eu-central` (pods restarted one at a time).

priya (eng-reliability): monitoring: 5xx decreased to baseline within ~4 minutes. no new correctness complaints yet. tagging incident as customer-impact-mitigated. please keep watch for 30m.

tess (support): BetaRetail confirmed decreased failures; they reported brief degradation for ~22 minutes total.

mohit (platform): implemented temporary compatibility block: `if fallback_target in incompatible_models: skip_fallback` applied to policy runtime as a quick guard. will push a small test to CI.

elaine (oncall): follow-ups (to postmortem): 1) enforce server-side expression validation at publish time (reject on syntax/regex errors) 2) add preapply canary that compiles policies in a sandbox for all regions 3) extend policy test harness to validate model compatibility matrix before allowing fallback routes 4) surface parse errors as a distinct low-noise alert with runbook 'policy-compile-failure' 5) label risky policy changes (regexes/expressions) for manual review if no automated tests exist.

sam (eng-sre): documenting mitigation steps + commands in I-2026-335. leaving a 60m observation window. handing to elaine for oncall transition.

elaine (oncall): handing off watch to sam for the next hour. taking notes for postmortem. thanks all.

incident-bot: Incident I-2026-335 created by elaine, severity S2. linked alerts: alert_9122, alert_9123. runbook: /runbooks/policy-compile-failure.
